description: Every Salesbuildr resource as a scriptable command, plus offline margin and pipeline analytics.

novel_features.name: Stale-quote radar
novel_features.description: Surface quotes that have been sent or approved but are aging past a cutoff, with the dollar value still at risk.

novel_features.name: Low-margin line radar
novel_features.description: Find every quote line item across all open quotes whose markup falls below a floor.

novel_features.name: Quote funnel
novel_features.description: See stage-by-stage conversion of the quote lifecycle — count and dollar value at draft, sent, approved, declined, and expired.

novel_features.name: Price-drift radar
novel_features.description: Flag per-company pricing-book prices that have diverged from the master catalog price or cost.

novel_features.name: Pipeline velocity
novel_features.description: Aggregate sales-cycle duration and time-in-stage across the opportunity pipeline.

novel_features.name: Win-rate breakdown
novel_features.description: Compute won/lost ratios grouped by owner, stage, or category.

novel_features.name: Product velocity
novel_features.description: Rank catalog products by how often they appear across quote line items and the total value quoted — your de-facto bestsellers.

novel_features.name: PSA reconcile by external id
novel_features.description: Find rows across companies, contacts, products, and opportunities whose external identifier is missing — the records that silently miss a PSA sync.

novel_features.name: Recurring-revenue forecast
novel_features.description: Weight open-pipeline monthly revenue and profit by probability, churn-adjusted.

novel_features.name: Company whitespace
novel_features.description: Show catalog products a company has never been quoted — the cross-sell gaps.
